source_title: Discounted valuations offset near-term headwinds for Tata Consumer - Business Standard
source_excerpt: Tata Consumer Products Ltd (TCPL) on Monday reported its results for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27 (Q2FY27), which met or exceeded consensus. Consolidated revenue was up 14 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) at ₹5,661 crore, with India volume up 11 per cent Y-o-Y. TCPL has taken price hikes of 8-10 per cent in many products in FY27 to date. The portfolio mix is changing with a focus on growth areas.
